newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall on improved supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall on improved supply.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell in moderate trade on Friday on increased supplies, dealers said.

They said castorseed March delivery fell to 1,176/1,178 rupees per quintal from 1,182/1,183 on speculative offerings. Arrivals of castorseed in the western Indian Gujarat region were 20,000/25,000 thousand bags (75 kg) on Friday against last week's daily average of 14,000/15000 bags, they said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 343/344 rupees per 10 kg on poor demand despite limited arrivals of 70/80 tonnes and reports of arrivals of around 5,500 tonnes of imports, dealers said.
In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 520/525 rupees per 15 kg.
